bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Monday) the track is rated a soft 5 and with fine, cool weather forecast it should remain in that condition. AL MAXIMUS displayed encouraging second up improvement when making good ground form the back over 1650m second and was again good to the line over 1880m last time. The rise to 2100m is ideal now. DON'T GIVE UP beat him home last start but meets him 2.5kg worse. HAPPY CLAN is racing well but has found a win elusive this time in. TIDEFORD will lead them up and give a sight.

raceTips.comment: Don't Give Up is racing in good form and looks to have found a winnable race here. Merlin Beach is extremely consistent and should get a soft run but is some query at the trip. Al Maximus and Happy Clan at their best can win here but can mix their form.

bestBets.overview: GEEGEES AVALANCHE was posted wide but kept finding the line on debut, then tired after sitting outside a dominant all-the-way victor next try. From the kind draw he should enjoy a gun run just off the speed and can bounce back. His stablemate AUTHORISED ACCESS was game in defeat when confidently backed at his first attempt and will only be improved. UNFILTRED closed well when placing fresh and is yet to run a bad race. Fellow Blacker representative GOLD ARMOUR is also showing promise.

raceTips.comment: Authorised Access trialled well prior to a solid first up run where he started favourite in a strong maiden. He should get a nice run here and be right in the finish. Tsuyoi Kitsune has shown ability at the trials and could ran a bold race fresh. Gold Amour looks ready now fully fit.

bestBets.overview: SKY LAND scored a tough on-pace win two starts ago, then was game in defeat after facing the breeze last time. She drops 4kg on the latest thanks to the claim for Tayla Cameron and maps to get all the favours. The speedy FLYING BILLIE draws to advantage and will take catching if able to dictate the tempo. VERBANO was never likely last time but was strong to the line at her two previous outings and is deserving of another chance back in grade. FIGHTING FLOYD improved sharply to score second up before being ridden upside down last start.

raceTips.comment: Verbano got too far back last start but was strong late. She's got a light weight here and is drawn to get favours in run, she can improve sharply here. Flying Billie will dictate the speed and could get every favour. Fighting Floyd won two runs back but can mix his form.

bestBets.overview: ROYAL DETECTIVE had support and found the line nicely when resuming over 1100m. He'll be better for it, drops 2kg and is suited by the rise to 1390m. MEGALITA finished off hard to score second up before proving no match for the victor late last time. SH'BOURNE POWER was just outgunned as fave fresh and should have plenty of admirers again. NANDI CLAN has been sound at both runs back from a break, gets in light after the claim and won a trial here on July 20.

raceTips.comment: Royal Detective hasn't had much luck in recent runs and could improve sharply here now fitter.  Sh'bourne Power won well last start and is very progressive. Megalita is now fully fit and has the ability to win here.

bestBets.overview: TSUNAMI SAM has battled away gamely after leading at both runs back from a break. He's since won a trial here and should have little trouble holding the front again from the inside marble. He'll take plenty of catching. IN THE OCEAN was given a gun run when bolting in second up and will be even fitter now. ALVARHINO was better when weighing in second up but was given every chance there. DAYTONA DIVA impressed scoring a soft fresh win before finding a couple better at the short quote second up.

raceTips.comment: Daytona Diva got caught three wide last start in a slowly run race, it was a horror watch for those on at odds on. I'm happy to forgive that run and think she can bounce back to her best here. In The Ocean won in dominant style last start. Tsunami Sam will find the lead and dictate the race, he could be hard to rundown.

bestBets.overview: GEEGEES MISSILE failed to finish off as an easing fave fresh. She'll be better for the hitout and looked very progressive last time in. Expect sharp improvement. Her speedy stablemate ALPINE THUNDER draws to advantage and is sure to be in it for a long way. BILLIE THE GREAT has held form well since prevailing narrowly fresh and there's no reason to think that she can't play a role in the finish again. WITHIN SIGHT found form quickly last prep and has tuned up for this with a trial win.

raceTips.comment: Geesgees Missile is the class horse, she was poor first up but her best would just win here. Billie The Great will need some luck from back in the field but has been racing in consistent form. Alpine Thunder could get all the favours on speed.

bestBets.overview: ALL INTRIGUE was good to the line in the Sires' Produce. She has to take on older rivals but the rise to 1600m looks right up her alley. DON TURBOAS scored an overdue maiden win third up before finishing off strongly to just miss when out to this trip last time. FRENCH SOUL found the line nicely when out to 1350m second up and the further rise in trip looks ideal on that effort. THEM'S THE BREAKS didn't get room when required fresh before closing well to place second up.

raceTips.comment: French Soul should be suited to the mile and looks set to peak now fully fit. Don Turboas is very consistent and has relished rising in distance of late. Gold Tianna won in good style last start.

bestBets.overview: REGAL HUNTER appears to have his hoof right on the till having been game in defeat at his past two outings on synthetic. He's not unsuited back to turf and should get all the favours form the inside alley. SIR JAG is racing in career-best form and should be right in the thick of things again. THISISMYTURF looks close to another win having hit the line hard to place at his past couple. FLOSSING made good ground from the back in an improved showing second up and will be even fitter now.

raceTips.comment: Flossing got way too far back last start but still ran well considering. Now fully fit he can improve sharply here with the blinkers going on. Jonnie Pinch will give a big sight on speed. Sir Jag has been racing in great form of late. Regal Hunter was ok late last start but in easier grade.

bestBets.overview: SOUTHERN AURORAS was confidently backed when overcoming a wide gate to score fresh. She'll only be improved, draws better and can complete the double. The well travelled BENEFITSOFMINE finished off hard to score at his local debut and should again be strong when it counts. HUBUBBAJAHN was only worn down late after leading third up and draws to be in this for a long way as well. TRIBAL COUNCIL plummets 5.5kg on his latest sound effort and must be included in exotics/quaddies.

raceTips.comment: Benefitsofmine was held up for much of the straight last start, he found clear air the last 100m and zoomed home to win running the fastest last 200m sectional of the meeting. That was his first run for the new stable, he'll be incredibly hard to beat if he holds his form. Southern Auroras won well last start and looks to have found another nice race here. Outbush comes throughs a high rating race last start and has claims here.
